subject: Kickoff: active learning for free-energy prediction
body:
Hi Santiago, team,

Kicking off the active-learning-for-FEP work. The nice property of this codebase is that the whole active learning cycle is defined by a single ConfigDict configuration file — model_config, features, targets, selection_config — and you can override any parameter from the command line. That means the loop is a config artifact, not a codebase fork, which is exactly what our screening partners need.

Product framing: a configurable screening loop where a partner points at a CSV of SMILES and gets an acquisition-ranked list back.

Milestones: baseline cycles reproduced by mid-May, greedy vs. alternative selection comparison in June, internal readout the week of July 6.

Anders
